source.description: An eight-panel repaired raster contact sheet showing one consistent cheeky cartoon cheetah cub peeking over a ledge, progressing from pale construction to thick felt-tip outlines, accurate solid cheetah spots, and restrained marker color.
source.notes: This owner-directed correction replaces the technically accurate but underpowered full-page pattern exercise with a character-rich cub lesson. The published simple-pattern contact sheet and JPG masters are preserved privately under drafts/cheetah-print-pattern/simple-pattern-v1/. A second owner review caught step 5 looking in the opposite direction from steps 6 through the finish; the mismatched sheet and panel are preserved under drafts/cheetah-print-pattern/eye-direction-shift-v2/. A third owner review caught step 4's iris-like interior curves implying that same wrong gaze before the pupils appeared; that superseded sheet and panel are preserved under drafts/cheetah-print-pattern/eye-guide-shift-v3/. The canonical v4 gaze-sequence repair leaves both step 4 eye openings blank and introduces both rightward pupils only in step 5. The cub must keep the same slightly tilted near-front head angle, ear tilt, ledge, two forepaws, asymmetric side-eye, raised brow, small canine, two facial tear stripes, and solid irregular spots. No leopard rosettes, full body, tail, jungle scenery, text, sticker edge, badge frame, logo, or extra prop is allowed.

process_strategy: Use eight cumulative stages so the ledge occlusion, head anatomy, two paws, face, expression, species-specific tear stripes, solid spots, and color each receive a visible instructional job before the final reinforcement panel.

final_elements.name: fixed peeking pose and occlusion map
final_elements.description: One slightly tilted near-front head gesture, one horizontal ledge with thickness, two forepaw centers on its top edge, two ear axes, a face axis, and a reserved muzzle footprint; the ledge permanently hides the lower body.

final_elements.name: head ear muzzle paw and ledge construction
final_elements.description: A rounded head and cheek block, two uneven rounded-triangle ears, one broad muzzle oval, two mitten-like forepaws draped over the ledge, and the ledge top and front planes.

final_elements.name: connected cub silhouette
final_elements.description: One stable outer contour connecting the head, cheeks, ears, short visible neck, two paws, and ledge without drawing a hidden torso below the ledge.

final_elements.name: inner ears eyes muzzle nose and canine
final_elements.description: Two inner-ear shapes, one wide blank almond eye opening, one narrower blank half-lidded eye opening, a divided cream muzzle, one compact nose, a small off-center mouth opening, and one small triangular canine; no iris or pupil appears yet.

final_elements.name: asymmetric side-eye expression paw details and neck spot anchors
final_elements.description: Both pupils glancing toward the right side of the image, one raised curved brow, one crooked smirk, exactly three short toe marks on each established forepaw, and two small solid-spot anchors on the visible neck.

final_elements.name: cheetah tear stripes and solid spot layout
final_elements.description: Exactly two dark tear stripes running from the inner eye corners toward the muzzle plus the remaining restrained, asymmetrical layout of irregular closed solid spots across the forehead, cheeks, outer ears, visible neck, and forepaws; no rings or open centers.

final_elements.name: black ink and limited marker color
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines and fills, golden-ochre fur, cream muzzle and paw tips, dusty-coral inner ears, a muted deep-green ledge, directional marker streaks, and intentional warm-paper highlights.

rejection_checks: The same cub, near-front head angle, ear tilt, ledge, two paws, crop, and scale must persist through all eight panels.
The ledge must hide the lower body from step 1 onward, its top edge must stop behind the two reserved paws, and no finished torso detail may be drawn only to disappear.

Step 4 must keep both eye openings blank with no iris or pupil; step 5 must introduce both pupils aimed toward the right side of the image, and that gaze, both eye shapes, one raised brow, one small canine, two tear stripes, six total toe marks, and every solid spot must persist through the finish.
Every marking must be a closed irregular solid spot or one of the two facial tear stripes; no leopard rosette, open center, decorative ring, or full-page pattern field is allowed.
No tail, full body, jungle scenery, text, logo, sticker edge, badge frame, extra prop, extra character, or final-only motif may appear.
The finish must show handmade felt-tip edges, directional marker streaks, and warm-paper gaps rather than vector-perfect outlines, glossy gradients, or poster polish.
